item.title: Zimbabwe businessman Wicknell Chivayo killed in helicopter crash

item.title: Funeral held for DR Congo politician killed after defending Ebola response

item.title: Afghanistan says Pakistani airstrikes killed women and children
item.description: Afghan officials say at least nine women and children were killed and 11 people wounded by Pakistani air attacks.

item.description: Coffins containing the remains of those killed will be carried in a funeral procession involving family members.

item.description: A pilot who stabbed another pilot on an Israel-bound plane is being investigated in Saudi Arabia, Benjamin Netanyahu says.

item.title: Zimbabwe tycoon Wicknell Chivayo and wife killed in helicopter crash
item.description: Chivayo was known for his lavish lifestyle, close ties to African presidents and lucrative government contracts.

item.title: Inside India's forest villages, where a dangerous mix of crises led to 32 child deaths
item.description: At least 32 children have died in India's Balaghat district since May amid outbreaks of measles and malaria.

item.title: Flydubai passenger describes putting attacker in chokehold after cockpit stabbing
item.description: Other passengers on the Israel-bound flight described the "terrifying" moment the plane dropped.
